messages.author: fb40a65bd21dcf6f
messages.subject: ADVI initialisation
parts:
Thanks again for Stan! I'm finding the ADVI algorithm very useful for exploring my model. However I wonder if there is any way to initialise the means of the meanfield Gaussians in the transformed space? For some of my parameters I have some good guesses that I'd like to try as starting points. In fact also how does the initialisation work? Is it random?

Thanks,
John.

messages.author: 49e107cb0f8a3d27
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ADVI initialisation
parts:
Hi John, There’s an init argument which enables you to specify the means in the original (possibly constrained) latent variable space; see CmdStan manual for more details. I don’t believe we currently support initialization in the transformed/unconstrained space(?). It should be the same as if MCMC initializations supports it.

If you know the transformations beforehand, which are given in the manual, you can of course apply the inverse of the functions to your desired transformed parameters, and use them as initializations on the original parameter space.

Dustin
